name: TexPageFormat
meaning: texture page format word (PolyBatcher::LoadTexturePages; bits 2-4 are a field)

name: TEXFMT_PIXEL_MASK
meaning: LoadTexturePages: format & 3 is the page's TextureFormat, passed to the Texture constructor

name: TEXFMT_KIND_IMMEDIATE
meaning: (format & TEXFMT_KIND_MASK) == 4: an immediate page with its own batch (the file lists these first); state flags DITHER | TEXTURED | FILTER_LINEAR

name: TEXFMT_KIND_BLEND
meaning: a sorted page drawn alpha-blended: state flags BLEND_ALPHA | TEXTURED | FILTER_LINEAR

name: TEXFMT_KIND_ADD
meaning: a sorted page drawn additively: state flags BLEND_ADD | TEXTURED | FILTER_LINEAR; any other kind after the immediate pages makes LoadTexturePages return 0
